**Order Date:** June 29, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

**CRITERIA MET:**

- **Sleep Apnea Evaluation:** Documented. In-person sleep medicine consultation with Dr. J. Holm on May 16, 2025, for loud snoring and witnessed breathing pauses.

- **Diagnostic Testing:** Documented. Home sleep apnea test (Type III) on June 4, 2025, showed apnea-hypopnea index of 38.4 events/hour with 261 total respiratory events, meeting Medicare requirements.

**INFORMATION REQUIRED:**

- **CPAP Education:** We do not have documentation that the patient or caregiver received instruction from the CPAP supplier on proper use and care of the equipment. Please submit:
  - Supplier education records, training notes, or patient acknowledgment of instruction on CPAP operation and maintenance

Please send the missing documentation to our office within 10 business days. We will complete our review upon receipt.
